# Ting 0.7.7
## Fixed
- New bindings in Settings › Bindings now start with no keys. Ting no longer assigns the first free key (usually A) before you record a sequence. - A new binding is saved only after you enter its keys and click **Done**. **Cancel** or Escape discards the draft without adding a binding. - Editing an existing binding still starts with its current sequence.
## Upgrade
A downloaded copy: choose **Check for Updates…** in Ting. A Homebrew copy: choose **Update Ting via Homebrew…** in Ting's menu. Settings, bindings, micro-apps and permissions are preserved. Requires macOS 14 or later; the signed, notarized and stapled universal app supports Apple Silicon and Intel.
